home.title: Sales channels
home.description: Storefront connections, their deliveries, and what needs attention.
home.emptyBody: Channels connect storefronts like Shopify to OpenBooks. Each connection syncs products, takes orders, and files every delivery in its activity log for replay.

tiles.attentionSub: Failed or dead — review the queue
tiles.ordersTodaySub: Order sync arrives with the first connector

home.attentionHint: Deliveries that failed or dead-lettered, with the channel that owns them.
home.attentionReason: {failed, plural, =0 {} other {# failed · }}{dead, plural, =0 {} other {# dead}}
home.channelsHint: One card per storefront, with its health and actions.
home.cardAttention: {count, plural, one {# delivery needs} other {# deliveries need}} attention
home.pauseBody: New deliveries wait while the channel is paused. Nothing already stored is lost.
home.resumeBody: Waiting deliveries process again from where they stopped.
home.disconnectBody: The storefront stops delivering. Past orders, links, and history stay in OpenBooks.
home.disconnectVerify: Disconnect {name}? Its history stays, but no new deliveries arrive.
home.advancedBody: Delivery verification and per-event posting detail live on each channel's workspace, under its Activity and Settings tabs.
home.connectBody: Name the connection and tell OpenBooks which storefront account it is. The signing secret below registers with the storefront.
home.secretBody: Register this signing secret with the storefront now — it seals and never shows again.
home.marginHint: Trailing 30-day contribution by channel, after fulfilment and fees
home.marginEmpty: Margin appears here once channel orders post with costs. Refresh an order to build it now.
home.marginPrecisionUnknown: Margin in {currency} cannot be shown: {currency} has no precision in the ISO currency registry (read-only reference data). Ask your system administrator to restore the missing row with the platform currency seed.

completeness.title: Today's completeness
completeness.hint: Whether today's storefront sales reached the ledger, with the remedy on each open proof.
completeness.clear: Today's storefront sales are fully in the books.

home.marginUnreadable: Margin in {currency} cannot be shown: a stored value is not readable. Posted detail stays as stored; ask your system administrator to review the stored records.

workspace.attentionBanner: {count, plural, one {# delivery needs} other {# deliveries need}} attention — review the Activity tab.
workspace.healthEmpty: No sync streams report yet. Health appears once the connector runs.
workspace.recentEmpty: No deliveries yet. The storefront's first webhook appears here.
workspace.settingsHint: Posting accounts and stock locations for this channel. Changes take effect for new orders; history is never rewritten.
workspace.reviewBanner: This connection finished importing and is ready to review: matches, locations and posting accounts are proposed.

activity.emptyBody: Deliveries from the storefront appear here with their verification and processing state.
activity.replaySelected: Replay {count, plural, one {# delivery} other {# deliveries}}
activity.replayTitle: Replay {count, plural, one {# delivery} other {# deliveries}}?
activity.replayBody: The deliveries run through the connector again. Already-applied effects stay applied — replay is idempotent.

toast.replayed: {count, plural, one {# delivery} other {# deliveries}} requeued.

activity.title: Webhook deliveries
activity.emptyHint: Verified Shopify deliveries land here newest first, with their outcome.
activity.replayHint: Requeue this delivery with a reason. The attempt is audited.

links.unlinkBody: The {provider} object in account {externalAccount} stays, but OpenBooks stops mapping it here.
links.emptyBody: No external IDs yet. Storefront and provider identities linked to this record appear here.

connect.title: Connect Shopify
connect.shopHint: The xxx.myshopify.com domain from Shopify admin Settings.
connect.oauthHint: Approve OpenBooks in a Shopify tab, then return here for the review.
connect.tokenHint: From Shopify admin Apps → Develop apps → Install, with the scopes listed in Settings.
connect.secretHint: The custom app's client secret — webhook deliveries verify against it.
connect.pushHint: Off unless you price in OpenBooks. Lets item price and title updates write back to variants.
connect.matchedLine: {sku} matched by SKU · {barcode} matched by barcode · {queued} need a decision
connect.accountsHint: Unmapped roles refuse at posting time — accepting early never mis-posts.
connect.acceptHint: Saving stores the accounts and activates the channel.
connect.reviewTimedOut: Shopify approval was not ready within five minutes. Complete approval in Shopify, then refresh to retry.

products.matchHint: Link this variant to the item it already is.
products.createFamilyHint: Every queued variant becomes its own item; the Shopify SKU becomes the item code when free.
products.ignoreHint: Park this row without linking it. Re-import never un-ignores it.
products.unmatchHint: Remove the link with a reason. The row queues again.
products.emptyHint: New and changed storefront variants queue here for a decision.
products.proposalSkuChanged: SKU changed at Shopify from {from} to {to}. Confirm it still means this item.
products.proposalDeleted: Deleted at Shopify. Unmatch to release the link.

locations.emptyHint: Import the storefront locations, then map each to the stock location it fulfils from.
locations.unmappedHint: Orders naming this location park in the exception queue — nothing moves until it is mapped.
locations.fulfilsOnHint: Sales move stock from this shelf when they post; the storefront never needs to report back.
locations.fulfilsOffHint: Sales post without moving stock; the storefront's fulfilments move it later, and a missing fulfilment leaves the shelf untouched.
locations.bufferHint: Units held back from the storefront at this location.
locations.stopHint: When the pushed quantity reaches zero, the variant stops selling instead of overselling.
locations.conflictsTitle: {count, plural, one {# stock conflict needs a decision} other {# stock conflicts need a decision}}
locations.conflictsHint: Shopify changed these quantities outside OpenBooks. Pushing overwrites nothing until you decide.
locations.overrideSummary: {count, plural, one {# per-item override} other {# per-item overrides}}
locations.overrideHint: Advanced: hold back more, change the stop policy, or pause pushes for one item. Empty means inherit the location.

settings.title: Channel settings
settings.autoImportHint: New storefront variants join the match queue on their own.
settings.syncInventoryHint: Storefront stock levels are recorded on their deliveries.
settings.pushHint: Lets item price and title updates write back to linked variants. Off by default.
settings.advancedSummary: API version, rate budget and webhook topics
settings.apiVersionHint: Pinned quarterly version for every call. Change only to adopt a newer Shopify release.
settings.rateLimitHint: Maximum API cost one import may spend before stopping. Re-import resumes.
settings.webhookUrlHint: Point the Shopify app notifications here. Deliveries verify against the stored app secret.

toast.loadFailed: Could not load. Check your connection and try again.

title: Channel orders
description: Every storefront order with its posting status and document link.
exceptionsDescription: Orders that cannot post, with the fix for each. Nothing here posts until it is fixed.
postingDescription: How each channel turns storefront orders into accounting, and from which date.

empty.ordersDescription: Orders appear here when a connected storefront sends them. Connect a channel first.
empty.exceptionsDescription: Every order posted or is waiting for its daily summary.
empty.eventExceptionsTitle: No blocked refunds, cancellations or fulfilments
empty.eventExceptionsDescription: Every storefront event posted. Blocked ones land here with the fix.

drawer.unknownPrecision: Amounts in {currency} cannot be shown: {currency} has no precision in the ISO currency registry (read-only reference data). If the order is parked, follow its exception remedy in Exceptions, then replay the order.
drawer.replayAllEvents: Replay all events with this cause
drawer.noDocument: No document yet. The order posts when it can.
drawer.storedValueNote: {amount} was paid with stored value: it settles the gift liability, so it reads here as context and never as a cost.
drawer.mixedCurrencyNote: A cost arrived in another currency that no rate can price, so it stays beside the totals. Record the rate to restate the order.
drawer.noEconomicsBody: Refresh to build this order’s margin from its lines, costs, and fees. Late costs restate the margin with history.
drawer.unreadableAmount: An amount in {currency} cannot be shown: the stored value is not readable. Re-import or replay the source event from the channel's Activity tab.
drawer.unknownPrecisionFrozen: Amounts in {currency} cannot be shown: {currency} has no precision in the ISO currency registry (read-only reference data). Posted history is immutable and replay cannot rewrite it; ask your system administrator to restore the missing row with the platform currency seed.
drawer.unreadableAmountFrozen: An amount in {currency} cannot be shown: the stored value is not readable. Posted history is immutable and replay cannot rewrite it; ask your system administrator to review the stored record.

assistance.loadFailed: The proposed fix did not load. Replay the order or try again.
assistance.similar: {count, plural, one {# order shares} other {# orders share}} this cause
assistance.rejected: Rejection recorded in the audit log.
assistance.confirmBody: {fix} This replays {count, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}}. Posted history keeps its accounts.

timeline.empty: No refunds, fulfilments or cancellations yet.

posting.modePerOrderDescription: Each paid order posts its own cash sale immediately.
posting.modeDailySummaryDescription: One cash sale per channel, day, location and currency at the cut-off.
posting.unpaidCreatesSalesOrder: Create a sales order for unpaid orders we fulfil
posting.guestCustomerDescription: Leave blank to create a customer per order.
posting.saved: Posting policy saved, effective {date}. Orders already posted keep their documents.
posting.noPolicy: This channel has no posting policy yet. Orders wait until you choose a mode.
posting.advancedSummary: Cut-off time zone, excluded tags and sources, and policy history.

itemTab.title: Channels
itemTab.emptyHint: Link this item to a Shopify variant under Channels, then its storefront stock appears here.
